_about: Why-card texts (docs/design/karsilastirma-ve-aciklama.md, 'Neden kartlari'). No numbers here: every number in a card comes from the server answer and is filled in by features/why/explain.ts. Placeholders: {better}, {worse}, {a}, {b}, {amount}, {label}, {input}.

common.same: {a} and {b} have the same value for {label}.
common.none_known: None of the six metrics has a computed value in both scenarios yet, so there is nothing to explain.
common.unknown: {label} has no computed value in at least one of these scenarios, so there is nothing to explain yet.
common.one_input: {a} and {b} differ in one input only, the {input}, so the whole difference comes from it.
common.counterfactual_intro: Each row keeps {a} as it is and changes one input to the value in {b}. The server computed every row.
common.counterfactual_note: The rows need not add up to the total: inputs can work together.
common.same_inputs: {a} and {b} ask the same question, so there is no difference to explain.

sunlit_fraction.explore: {better} gets {amount} more sunlight than {worse} in this period.
sunlit_fraction.classroom: The server counts a moment as sunlit when the Sun is above the local horizon in the Sun's direction.

longest_dark_hours.explore: The longest dark spell at {better} is {amount} shorter than at {worse}.
longest_dark_hours.classroom: A dark spell lasts from the moment the Sun drops below the local horizon until it comes back above it.

max_sun_elevation_deg.explore: At {better} the Sun climbs {amount} higher than at {worse}.
max_sun_elevation_deg.classroom: This is the highest angle of the Sun's centre above the flat horizon during the period. It depends on where the site is and on the dates.

earth_visible_fraction.explore: {better} has Earth in view for {amount} more than {worse} in this period.
earth_visible_fraction.classroom: Earth counts as in view when it is above the local horizon, by the criterion the scenario uses. Direct radio contact needs Earth in view.

longest_earth_hidden_hours.explore: The longest stretch without Earth in view is {amount} shorter at {better} than at {worse}.
longest_earth_hidden_hours.classroom: This is the longest time Earth stays below the local horizon in the period, by the criterion the scenario uses.

mean_power_w.explore: A panel at {better} makes {amount} more on average than at {worse}.
mean_power_w.classroom: Panel power is computed from the Sun's position, the local horizon and the panel profile. The panel values are assumed, not measured.
